# Leveling a Shaman — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on enhancement (10 members), restoration (9 members). The main line is **enhancement** — Endgame build (level 60), 17/34/0, with a respec at level 60. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/shaman/*/talents.yaml`]

**This page is the bots' half.** It records which spec the bots level with, the talent order they execute level by level, the abilities their kit teaches and the consumables they carry. The hand-written guide for this class is [leveling.md](./leveling.md).

## Situational rules

Sentences copied from the rules' own notes, where the poison/creature-type, seal, stance, form and consumable advice lives.

### Elemental

- **SE00c-water-breathing-pre-swim:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) every member enters with at least five minutes of Water Breathing: a buff placed for an earlier stretch ran out in the next one.
- **SE00b-water-breathing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): covered_by [5697, 1066] (v30): a member in Aquatic Form or carrying the other breath buff is skipped. HO-TKB-PLAY-139 (owner, 2026-10-08: the party's shaman or warlock buffs every member before a swim and refreshes it while the party is underwater; druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims): Water Breathing (131, instant, 10 min, 30 yd) on every member, the resident included, who lacks it or has under two minutes left (party_missing with refresh_below_ms, v28), while the party walks or holds at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) or any member is submerged; in combat too, since a buff running out mid-fight underwater is how a member drowns.
- **SE00r-ancestral-spirit:** No elemental shaman is fielded; the same gap as SN00r.
- **SE01t-tremor-totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-155 (orchestrator, the fear bosses): the enhancement and restoration rule in the elemental rotation, which had none. From enhancement: HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Tremor Totem while a member is feared (party.any_feared): "Tremor on fear fights" in the earth slot instead of Strength of Earth, which yields while anyone is feared (restoration.md L125; enhancement.md L163).
- **SE01-lightning-shield:** 40 mana, 10 min, and it is an aura on the shaman, so unlike a totem it can be gated. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **SE02-water-shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SE03-elemental-mastery:** HO-TKB-PLAY-246 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Elemental Mastery only right before a fresh Flame Shock (Flame Shock missing and castable, target not fire-immune): "Elemental Mastery right before a fresh Flame Shock so the whole DoT snapshots" (guide L127, L20, L22), mistake L198 "popping Elemental Mastery after Flame Shock". Elemental talent (231) taken at 30; free, 180 s recoveryTime, 10 s of crit and cheaper casts, and it is the DependsOn of Earthquake.
- **SE04c-tremor-totem-halgan:** HO-TKB-PLAY-187 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator; amp-6's Dragonmaw strategy item 1): Halgan Redbrand (62069) casts ONE Psychic Scream, a fear, when his health first falls to 50 per cent (boss_halgan_redbrand.cpp L54-L58 at the pin: `!m_bUsedPsychicScream and GetHealthPercent() <= 50`, cast on his victim). The old Tremor Totem rule waits for `party.any_feared`, i.e. until the fear has landed; Tremor Totem pulses every 3 seconds and breaks a fear in progress, so a totem already down when he screams ends it at once.
- **SE04b-grounding-totem-zevrim:** HO-TKB-PLAY-187 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator): the dungeon guide for Dire Maul says of Zevrim Thornhoof: "Shaman: re-drop Grounding Totem immediately after it is consumed, and pre-place it" ([dire-maul.md](../../instances/dire-maul.md), the Zevrim line). His Sacrifice (22651) is a 1 s cast on a random member; a Grounding Totem eats one spell aimed at the party, so it is the cheap answer to a landed Sacrifice (a teleport, an 8 s stun and a 300 per second leech).
- **SE04-grounding-totem:** Free, 20 s recoveryTime, 45 s duration, an air totem that eats one spell aimed at the party. It is in the file because it has a cooldown to gate on; the buff totems the checklist tabulates are not, for the reason the note gives.
- **SE05-earthbind-totem:** Free, 15 s recoveryTime, an earth totem that slows what is inside its radius.
- **SE06-purge:** Free at the pin, 8 s categoryRecoveryTime; DispelType 1 is magic, taken off the enemy. The one offensive dispel any class in this tree has.
- **SE07m-cure-poison-must:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **SE07-cure-poison:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SE08m-cure-disease-must:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **SE08-cure-disease:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SE09-earthquake:** Turtle content: an Elemental talent (234) at 40 that DependsOn Elemental Mastery, 225 mana, a 2500 ms cast, 16 s categoryRecoveryTime, 36 yd, and a slow on everything it hits.
- **SE00s-peel-11197:** Other Stratholme Undead adds are not sourced.
- **SE00s-caster-first-10499:** Its spell list (tkbplay-201.result.txt: 104990, Wail of Souls 17631, 7,580-8,059 hp, level 58-60) is instant and not interruptible per p4-group (spell_template: castingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0; not re-read here), so no interrupt rule can answer it and killing it is the only kit answer; same shape and gates as the 10471 rule, just ahead of it.
- **SE00s-caster-first-10471:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **SE00s-caster-first-10470:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **SE10-fire-nova-totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-246 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): at 4+ targets "add Fire Nova Totem when both [Earthquake and Chain Lightning] are on cooldown" (guide L23, L117). 95 mana, 15 s categoryRecoveryTime, and the totem fires a 10 yd nova around itself.
- **SE11-chain-lightning:** The threshold 2 is unchanged and is the archive's own ("Chain Lightning on cooldown (3 targets, -30% per bounce)" at 2-3 targets, with `aoe_threshold: 4` reserved for Fire Nova Totem and Earthquake).
- **SE13-earth-shock:** 30 mana, instant, 20 yd, 6 s categoryRecoveryTime, and its second effect is SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST. A bot only interrupted the mob it had selected, so with the party on another mob nobody stopped the heal or the cast (Jammal'an's Healing Wave, the Hateforge cleric's Greater Heal).
- **SE13-earth-shock-t1:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **SE13-earth-shock-t2:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of SE13-earth-shock, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **SE13-earth-shock-t3:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of SE13-earth-shock, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **SE14-frost-shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-189 (HO-188): not on Noxxion (13282, Razorfen Downs boss), whose creature_template school_immune_mask is 16 = frost `db:penqle_world.creature_template@tkbplay-189`; a stopgap until p1-loop's target.school_immune(k) (v40) lands, then it is replaced by the vocabulary term. HO-TKB-PLAY-191 (orchestrator; p1-loop v39 and v40): the Noxxion stopgap (target.boss and enemies_engaged_entry(13282)) is replaced by target.school_immune(4), the core's own per-school damage test; Noxxion's mask is 16, a frost-immune target of any entry is covered.
- **SE17-healing-wave:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **SE00u-wizard-oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 144); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
